note: shared/api/persister.ts's isPersistableKey is a default-deny allowlist gating which TanStack query keys may ever be written to localStorage. As of 2026-09-10 it checks against exactly one literal: 'me' (queryKeys.me), covering only the signed-in user's own profile. This ratchet is two-directional: a new key checked against in isPersistableKey that is not listed here fails scripts/verify/ratchets/persist-boundary.mjs, and a listed key isPersistableKey no longer checks against fails it too — this file may only change by a reviewed, dated edit, never by drift.

entries.reason: The only query persisted today (queryKeys.me, the signed-in user's own /me profile read) — safe because it can never carry another user's data. Adding a second key here must be a deliberate, reviewed decision, since anything persisted this way sits in localStorage in plaintext for up to buildPersistOptions()'s 24h maxAge.
